title: Evaluation of a statement gate
statement: Let $s$ be a straight-line statement, with operation $ ullet$ (conjunction or disjunction) and operands $a$ and $b$, and let $vals$ be a list of Boolean vertex values. The gate associated with $s$ evaluates to $ ullet(vals[v_a],vals[v_b])$, where $v_a$ and $v_b$ are the vertices associated with its two operands and any out-of-range list lookup is taken to be false.
hypotheses_covered: A list of Boolean vertex values $vals$
